editorial:
Imagine living in a gray, sleepy town where something always feels off. You follow three different people whose lives are falling apart at the same time. One person is dealing with a missing boy, another is being followed by a creepy stranger, and a father is hunting down the person who killed his kid. It feels heavy and tense from the start, making you feel like you are walking through those cold streets right along with them. The movie doesn't hold your hand; it just throws you into these sad and scary situations, leaving you wondering how these three separate stories will eventually crash into each other.

What really works here is the acting. You can tell the characters are hurting without them even saying a word. Some parts move a bit slow, but the tension makes up for it. If you like dark stories that make you think, you should definitely give this a try. It looks great in high definition, so try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best experience. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move since the visuals are so gritty and detailed.
endingExplained: The stories collide in a bleak finale where the cycle of pain continues. The man seeking revenge finally finds the killer, but the act of violence doesn't actually bring him the peace he wanted. The missing boy's plot ends on a sad note that shows how some people are just trapped by their surroundings. It wraps up by showing that while these people tried to escape their past, the trauma stays with them forever.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark crime stories and moody mysteries.
